claims.content: The System Administrator creates a new Individual User account by assigning them to a User Group and providing mandatory credentials (User Name, Password, Verify Password), ensuring password consistency and uniqueness of names.

goal.raw_text: The System Administrator creates a new Individual User account by assigning them to a User Group and providing mandatory credentials (User Name, Password, Verify Password), ensuring password consistency and uniqueness of names.

claims.content: System Administrator
The System Administrator must have the privilege to create User Groups, as only the system admin is able to create them.
User Groups must exist in the system to allow selection of a Group Name for the new Individual User.
The proposed User Name must be unique and not already exist in the system.
The System Administrator initiates the creation of a new Individual User account by selecting the option to add a user within the system.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates the creation of a new Individual User account by selecting the option to add a user within the system.

claims.content: The System Administrator selects the option to create a new Individual User account.
The System Administrator selects an existing User Group from which to assign the new user.
The System Administrator enters a unique User Name for the new Individual User.
The System Administrator enters a Password and then re-enters it in the Verify Password field.
The system validates that the Password and Verify Password values are equal before saving.
The system checks that the User Name is not already existing in the system.
Upon successful validation of all mandatory fields and constraints, the system saves the new Individual User account information.
If the Password and Verify Password values are not equal, the system does not save the user information.
If the User Name already exists in the system, the system does not allow the creation of the Individual User.
If the Password and Verify Password values are not equal, the system does not save the user information.
If the User Name already exists in the system, the system does not allow the creation of the Individual User.
The new Individual User account is saved in the system with all mandatory fields (Group Name, User Name, Password, Verify Password) populated.
The Password and Verify Password values are equal, as the system only saves user information when they match.
The User Name is unique and does not duplicate any existing user or group name in the system.
